purpose.objective: Convert the Phase 04 high-Brent/high-USDRUBF research regime into a deterministic PIT-safe short-USDRUBF candidate signal schedule for Phase 06 backtesting.

inputs.phase6_source_panel: explicit path required and semantic replay must reproduce frozen Phase6 dataset

signal_definition.regime_sampling_basis: Phase 04 eligible identity sequence; not a continuous daily Brent regime path
signal_definition.overlap_policy: accept earliest raw signal, then suppress raw signals until at least 21 source-panel session indices after the accepted entry
signal_definition.fixed_exit_execution: close of entry source-panel index plus horizon sessions
signal_definition.regime_exit_reason: Phase 04 regime is sampled only on eligible research identities, so continuous daily regime-exit timing is not observable
signal_definition.cost_grid_interpretation: predeclared stress grid only; not an assertion of exact realized brokerage/exchange/slippage cost

gates.G1_lineage: exact pinned Phase6 and Brent artifact hashes plus Phase6 semantic replay PASS
gates.G2_phase04_semantics: 126/63 percentile and 0.75 high thresholds exactly match Phase 04 repository implementation
gates.G3_pit_signal: raw signal uses prior_trade_date closes only and target session open is the earliest execution price
gates.G4_signal_direction: only high_high short-USDRUBF candidates are emitted
gates.G5_overlap: accepted entries are separated by at least 21 source-panel session indices; no pyramiding
gates.G6_exit_schedule: only fixed 5/10/20 session close schedules are emitted; no regime-exit inference
gates.G7_no_outcome_use: no future exit prices, forward returns, PnL, performance ranking, model fit or threshold/horizon optimization
gates.G8_research_only: no broker/trading actions, no sizing, no strategy promotion, no upstream mutation, no network
